business_model: B2B data/API licensing for parking and entrance locations derived from driver smartphone sensor data

technical_complexity.rationale: Inferring parking spots and entrances from noisy smartphone sensor streams requires sensor fusion and ML; the founders' control-theory and sensor-fusion background was central.

defensibility.rationale: Data accumulates from courier fleets and the sensor-fusion stack is specialized, but large map providers could build similar features; no patents found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: HERE discussed last-meter guidance in a 2025 blog; no acquisition or copying of truemetrics found.
